How to play

BlockSlides anywhere, corners included.
GateSame color and symbol: push through to escape.
StoneNever moves.
MovesOne drag = one move. ★★★ at par, ★★ within two over. Undo (↶) gives a move back; ? shows the next move.
AROUND THE GAME
♥ LivesRetrying a failed level costs one (from level 6). They refill over time; a rescue saves the attempt instead.
QuestsThree each day, shared by everyone. Finish all three to bank a streak freeze (hold up to 2).
StreakOne clear a day keeps it going. A banked freeze covers a missed day.
SurveyWeekly points — 1 per clear, +1 at par — with stamps at 3, 7, 12 and 20.
Chests24 ★ on a sheet opens its chest: a new paper for the drawing.
